roadmap.title: First jobs and basics
roadmap.description: Refuel, sleep, park automatically, ride a ferry and the channel train, and earn the first quick unlocks.

roadmap.title: Build your company
roadmap.description: Buy trucks and garages, hire drivers, and grow the company that several later unlocks depend on.

roadmap.title: Exploration and long hauls
roadmap.description: Discover roads and agencies, and finish the long, perfect, urgent and varied jobs of the base game.

roadmap.title: Driving Academy
roadmap.description: Finish the free Truck Driving Basics, Truck Driving Proficiency and Double Trailer Handling scenarios.

roadmap.title: Heavy Cargo and Special Transport
roadmap.description: Haul the oversize and heavy cargoes from these two cargo DLCs.

roadmap.title: Map DLC tasks
roadmap.description: Complete the city, landmark, viewpoint and delivery tasks of each map DLC.

roadmap.title: Cross-region finishers
roadmap.description: Run the very long routes that need several regions and the Going East! DLC.

roadmap.title: Upcoming content
roadmap.description: Hidden achievements for DLC that is not released yet.

achievements.description: Discover at least 20,000 kilometers of roads
achievements.summary: Discover 20,000 km of roads.

steps.text: Drive roads you have not used yet. On the navigation map they turn from light gray into yellow.
Follow the default navigation the first time you visit a city, then add waypoints on later visits to use other roads.
Set map exploration to @mechanic{Proximity Exploration} in the settings to discover roads near your truck without driving each one.

achievements.description: Discover at least 40,000 kilometers of roads
achievements.summary: Discover 40,000 km of roads.

steps.text: Keep driving new roads until you reach 40,000 km discovered.
Use @mechanic{Proximity Exploration} in the settings, extra waypoints and free roam to reach roads jobs do not cover.

achievements.description: Use the train to cross the channel
achievements.summary: Cross the channel by train.

steps.text: Use the channel train between @loc{Calais} and @loc{Dover}.

achievements.description: Utilize a boat
achievements.summary: Take a ferry with your truck.

steps.text: Pick a job or route that crosses water at a ferry. Dashed lines on the map mark ferry connections.
Drive onto the ferry and let it cross.

achievements.description: Discover at least 40 recruitment agencies
achievements.summary: Discover 40 recruitment agencies.

steps.text: Drive past agencies. They show as gray icons with a question mark on the map and unlock when you get near.
Keep going until you have found 40. Most cities have one, but not all.

achievements.description: Use at least 5 ports in the game (counts sea, river and train ports)
achievements.summary: Use five ports, counting sea, river and train ports.

steps.text: Use ferries and trains until you have used five ports in total. Each sea, river or train port counts.
Dashed lines on the map show which cities have a ferry.

achievements.displayName: From the Comfort of Your Home
achievements.description: Buy a truck online
achievements.summary: Buy a truck online.

steps.text: Own at least five trucks first. The online option is locked until then.
Open the dealer overview when buying a new truck and pick @mechanic{Buy Online}.

achievements.description: Design and apply to your truck a custom multi-color metallic paint
achievements.summary: Design and apply a custom multi-color metallic paint to your truck.

guide.context: Ready-made paint jobs that you only recolor do not count. Use the metallic paint design option.

steps.text: Open the paint shop for your truck and choose the metallic paint option.
Pick any colors and apply the paint.

achievements.description: Drive 999 km during jobs with each of at least 5 truck brands, only your owned trucks count
achievements.summary: Drive 999 km on jobs with each of five truck brands, using trucks you own.

guide.context: Only job distance counts. Free roam kilometers do not.

steps.text: Buy a truck of a new brand and drive jobs until it has covered 999 km.
Give the truck to an employee, then buy a truck of another brand and repeat.
Do this for any five of the seven brands: Volvo, Scania, Renault, Mercedes-Benz, MAN, Iveco and DAF.

achievements.description: Take an urgent delivery for a minimum of 550 km and complete it with less than 30 minutes remaining
achievements.summary: Complete an urgent delivery of at least 550 km with less than 30 minutes left on the timer.

steps.text: Put two points into the @mechanic{Just-In-Time Delivery} skill so urgent jobs appear.
Take an urgent job (marked with three arrows) of at least 550 km.
Arrive early, then park beside the road or in the city until under 30 minutes remain. Check the time left on the job screen (F6).
Deliver once less than 30 minutes remain. Do not wait on the company's property, where time runs much slower.

achievements.description: Complete a delivery that was greater than 2,000 km
achievements.summary: Complete a delivery longer than 2,000 km.

steps.text: Spend six skill points on @mechanic{Long Distance}.
Take a job over 2,000 km. These show up more often in cities near the map's border and with map expansions.

achievements.description: Perform jobs for at least 15 different companies in the game
achievements.summary: Perform jobs for 15 different companies.

steps.text: Deliver jobs for different companies, choosing a new company each time, until you have worked for 15.

achievements.description: Complete a job worth over €130,000 and minimum 2,200 km
achievements.summary: Finish a delivery that pays more than €130,000 and covers more than 2,200 km.

steps.text: Spend six skill points on @mechanic{Long Distance}.
Take a job over 2,200 km that pays more than €130,000, and deliver it.

achievements.description: Complete deliveries with following trailer types: Machinery, ADR cargo, Container, Refrigerated, Liquid cargo, Fragile cargo, Construction, Bulk cargo
achievements.summary: Complete deliveries with all eight trailer types: Machinery, ADR cargo, Container, Refrigerated, Liquid cargo, Fragile cargo, Construction and Bulk cargo.

guide.context: The game does not always show which trailer counts as which type. Using every filter category once makes sure you cover them.

steps.text: Do at least one job from every filter category in the job market: Livestock, Inloaders, Lowbeds, Flatbeds, Bulk Carriers, Container Chassis, Cisterns, Refrigerated & Insulated, and Curtainsiders & Dry Freighters.
Add a Special Transport job if you own that DLC.

achievements.displayName: Job Is Only Worth It If It's Done Well!
achievements.description: Complete a perfect delivery (no damage, no fines, in-time) for a job that is at least 1,000 km
achievements.summary: Complete a perfect delivery on a job of at least 1,000 km.

guide.context: Only cargo damage counts. Damage to the truck or trailer is fine, and fines can be turned off in the gameplay settings.

steps.text: Take a job of at least 1,000 km.
Arrive on time, with no fines and no damage to the cargo.

achievements.description: Complete 5 jobs in a row - in-time, without taking any damage to cargo and without using autoparking
achievements.summary: Complete five jobs in a row, each on time, with no cargo damage and without automatic parking.

steps.text: Take five short jobs inside one city.
Deliver each on time with no damage to the cargo.
Park each trailer yourself. Do not pick the no-XP automatic option.

achievements.displayName: Friends Are Always Here to Help You
achievements.description: Use automatic parking
achievements.summary: Finish a delivery with automatic parking.

steps.text: When you finish a job, pick the parking option that gives no bonus XP. The game parks the trailer for you.

achievements.description: Take and complete jobs with at least 30 different cargo
achievements.summary: Complete jobs with 30 different cargo types.

steps.text: Deliver 30 different cargo types. Writing down the cargo you have done helps you pick new ones.

achievements.description: Gain 20,000 XP for several consecutive jobs with the total distance below 10,000 km
achievements.summary: Earn 20,000 XP across several consecutive jobs that total under 10,000 km.

steps.text: You need more than 2 XP per kilometer, but normal jobs give about 1 XP per kilometer.
If you own the Special Transport DLC, chain its jobs. Each one pays over 2 XP for every kilometer, with no extra bonuses needed.
Stay under 10,000 km in total, then check you reached 20,000 XP.

achievements.description: Use quick travel to return to your headquarters
achievements.summary: Fast-travel back to your headquarters.

steps.text: Open the map and select your @loc{headquarters}, the garage you picked at the start of the save.
Choose the travel option. It costs some time and money.

achievements.description: Own at least one largest garage in your headquarter country
achievements.summary: Own a large garage in the country of your headquarters.

steps.text: Buy a garage in any city of the country where your headquarters stands.
Upgrade that garage to the largest size.
If your headquarters is in Luxembourg, there is no second city there, so upgrade your headquarters twice.

achievements.description: Own at least 30 garages
achievements.summary: Own at least 30 garages.

steps.text: Buy a garage in cities across the map. Each city has one garage that costs 180k.
Keep buying until you own 30. Upgrading them is not needed.
Towns, harbours and industry spots with a smaller name tag have no garage.

achievements.description: Achieve 100% of productivity for at least 5 large garages at the same time
achievements.summary: Have five large garages all at 100% productivity together.

steps.text: Upgrade five garages to the largest size.
Fill each one with drivers and keep them working until all five show 100% productivity together.

achievements.description: Reach an average daily profit of €450,000
achievements.summary: Earn €450,000 per day on average.

steps.text: Keep buying garages and hiring drivers until the company earns €450,000 per day on average.

achievements.description: Achieve at least 75% of the average garage productivity for 10 large garages in your company
achievements.summary: Reach 75% of the average garage productivity at ten large garages.

steps.text: Upgrade ten garages to the largest size.
Staff them with drivers until each one reaches 75% of the average garage productivity.

achievements.description: Have at least 10 female and 10 male employees of maximum level in your company
achievements.summary: Have 10 female and 10 male employees at maximum level.

steps.text: Hire many drivers and keep them working until at least 10 women and 10 men reach maximum level.

achievements.description: Use a rest stop
achievements.summary: Sleep at a rest stop.

guide.context: The prompt only appears once your driver is tired. If fatigue simulation is turned off in the gameplay settings, turn it back on.

steps.text: Park in a space marked with a hotel-bed icon, found in most cities and near highway fuel stations, and turn off the engine.
Accept the sleep prompt when it appears.

achievements.description: Use a filling station
achievements.summary: Refuel at a filling station.

steps.text: Drive to a @loc{filling station} when your fuel runs low and refuel.

achievements.description: Deliver truck cargo from Volvo Trucks factory (requires Scandinavia DLC)
achievements.summary: Haul a cargo of trucks that starts at the Volvo Trucks factory.

steps.text: Start a job at the Volvo factory in @loc{Göteborg}, Sweden.
Look for the cargo of two trucks on a flatbed.

achievements.description: Deliver truck cargo from Scania factory (requires Scandinavia DLC)
achievements.summary: Haul a cargo of trucks that starts at the Scania factory.

steps.text: Start a job at the Scania factory in @loc{Södertälje}, Sweden.
Look for the cargo of two trucks on a flatbed.

achievements.description: Deliver yachts to all Scandinavian marinas (requires Scandinavia and High Power Cargo Pack DLCs)
achievements.summary: Deliver cargo to all three Scandinavian marinas.

guide.context: Any cargo counts, not only yachts.

steps.text: Deliver to the marinas in @loc{Esbjerg} (Denmark), @loc{Oslo} (Norway) and @loc{Stockholm} (Sweden).
Any cargo works. It does not have to be yachts.

achievements.description: Deliver cargo to at least 1 container port in Scandinavia DLC (requires Scandinavia DLC)
achievements.summary: Deliver cargo to a container port in Scandinavia.

steps.text: Deliver to the container port company in @loc{Esbjerg} (Denmark) or @loc{Oslo} (Norway).

achievements.description: Complete a cattle delivery to any company in Scandinavia DLC (requires Scandinavia DLC)
achievements.summary: Deliver live cattle to a farm in Scandinavia.

steps.text: Search the job overview for @item{Live Cattle}. It has its own category.
Deliver it to a farm in @loc{Aalborg}, @loc{Esbjerg}, @loc{Jönköping} or @loc{Trelleborg}.

achievements.description: Discover at least 15 Scandinavia DLC cities (requires Scandinavia DLC)
achievements.summary: Discover 15 Scandinavian cities from the Scandinavia DLC.

guide.context: All of Denmark counts. In Norway only Stavanger, Oslo, Kristiansand and Bergen count. In Sweden only these count: Växjö, Västerås, Uppsala, Trelleborg, Södertälje, Stockholm, Örebro, Nynäshamn, Malmö, Linköping, Karlstad, Karlskrona, Kapellskär, Kalmar, Jönköping, Helsingborg and Gothenburg.

steps.text: Drive into 15 cities of Denmark, southern Norway and Sweden. A city turns yellow on the map when you visit.
Smaller places without a garage count too.

achievements.description: Complete delivery jobs to at least 3 quarries in Scandinavia DLC (requires Scandinavia DLC)
achievements.summary: Complete delivery jobs to 3 quarries in Scandinavia.

steps.text: Deliver to three of the seven quarries: Kristiansand, Oslo and Stavanger in Norway; Jönköping, Kalmar, Linköping and Växjö in Sweden.
Each country gives the quarry company its own name.

achievements.description: Travel across the Øresund Bridge between Copenhagen and Malmö (requires Scandinavia DLC)
achievements.summary: Cross the Øresund Bridge between Copenhagen and Malmö.

steps.text: Drive the E20 highway across the @loc{Øresund Bridge} between @loc{Copenhagen} and @loc{Malmö}.

achievements.description: Discover at least 20 French cities (requires Vive la France ! DLC)
achievements.summary: Discover 20 French cities from the Vive la France ! DLC.

steps.text: Drive into 20 French cities. A visited city turns yellow on the map.
A few cities in northern France come with the base game and count as well.

achievements.description: Discover following landmarks of France: Carcassonne, Brotonne bridge, Tiger tank, Peyrat-le-Château, Château de Ventadour, Château d'Ussé (requires Vive la France ! DLC)
achievements.summary: Discover all six French landmarks: Carcassonne, Brotonne Bridge, Tiger Tank, Peyrat-le-Château, Château de Ventadour and Château d'Ussé.

collectibles.name: Brotonne Bridge
collectibles.location: Under the fuel stop that lies south of @loc{Paluel}
collectibles.method: Drive past it.

collectibles.name: Carcassonne
collectibles.method: Drive past it.

collectibles.name: Château d'Ussé
collectibles.method: Drive past it.

collectibles.name: Château de Ventadour
collectibles.method: Drive past it.

collectibles.name: Peyrat-le-Château
collectibles.method: Drive past it.

collectibles.name: Tiger Tank
collectibles.location: North of @loc{Le Mans}, by a gas station
collectibles.method: Drive past it.

achievements.description: Deliver cargo to at least 3 nuclear plants in France (requires Vive la France ! DLC)
achievements.summary: Deliver cargo to 3 nuclear plants in France.

steps.text: Deliver to any three of the five plants: Saint-Laurent, Saint-Alban-du-Rhône, Paluel, Golfech and Civaux.
They are named places with a smaller tag, which means no garage.

achievements.description: Deliver cargo to at least 3 cargo airport terminals in France (requires Vive la France ! DLC)
achievements.summary: Deliver cargo to 3 cargo airport terminals in France.

steps.text: Deliver to three of the eight terminals: Bastia, Brest, Calvi, Clermont-Ferrand, Montpellier, Nantes, Paris and Toulouse.

achievements.description: Deliver diesel, LPG or petrol to at least 3 truck stops in France (requires Vive la France ! DLC)
achievements.summary: Deliver diesel, LPG or petrol to 3 truck stops in France.

steps.text: Spend a point on the fuel part of the @mechanic{ADR} skill.
Look for diesel, LPG or petrol jobs that end at truck stops. They are in Nantes, Montpellier, Marseille, Limoges, Le Mans, Le Havre and Bordeaux.
Quick jobs are your best option because these jobs are rare. Other ADR cargo does not count.

achievements.description: Deliver first Heavy Cargo (requires Heavy Cargo Pack DLC)
achievements.summary: Deliver your first heavy cargo.

steps.text: Take a job marked with the heavy cargo symbol and deliver it.

achievements.description: Complete a perfect delivery (no damage, no fines, in-time) of 3 consecutive Heavy Cargo Pack jobs (requires Heavy Cargo Pack DLC)
achievements.summary: Complete three heavy cargo jobs in a row, each as a perfect delivery.

steps.text: Take three short heavy cargo jobs.
Deliver each on time, with no fines and no cargo damage.

achievements.displayName: You Bet I Can Park It!
achievements.description: Collect 1,000 XP from parking on Heavy Cargo Pack deliveries (requires Heavy Cargo Pack DLC)
achievements.summary: Collect 1,000 parking XP on heavy cargo jobs.

steps.text: Park the trailer yourself on heavy cargo jobs. Skip the automatic option.
Each job gives 15 to 90 XP. Keep going until you have 1,000 XP from parking.

achievements.description: Deliver total of 250 tons of cargo on 5 consecutive jobs (requires Heavy Cargo Pack DLC)
achievements.summary: Deliver 250 tons of heavy cargo across five jobs in a row.

guide.context: Other jobs in between are fine as long as the five heavy jobs follow each other.

steps.text: Pick five heavy cargo jobs whose weights add up to at least 250 tons. The heaviest are Locomotive (61 t) and Concrete Beams (51 t).
Do the five jobs back to back. You can repeat a cargo.

achievements.displayName: I Thought This Should Be Heavy?!
achievements.description: Complete a delivery of at least 8 unique cargoes from the Heavy Cargo Pack (requires Heavy Cargo Pack DLC)
achievements.summary: Deliver 8 different heavy cargoes from the Heavy Cargo Pack.

steps.text: Deliver eight different heavy cargoes. The Heavy Cargo Pack has 11: Asphalt Miller, Concrete Beams, Dozer Crawl, Industrial Cable Reel, Locomotive, Locomotive CZ LOKO EffiShunter 300, Metal Centering, Mobile Crane, Mobile Crusher, Mobile Screener and Transformer.
Ignore jobs with a normal articulated trailer that only shows the heavy cargo symbol. They do not count.

achievements.description: Discover at least 15 Italian cities (requires Italia DLC)
achievements.summary: Discover 15 Italian cities from the Italia DLC.

steps.text: Drive into 15 Italian cities. A few cities in northern Italy come with the base game and count as well.

achievements.description: Own a garage in at least 2 Sicilian cities (requires Italia DLC)
achievements.summary: Have your own garage in each of two cities on Sicily.

steps.text: Buy a garage in two cities on Sicily, the island south of mainland Italy.

achievements.description: Deliver cargo to at least 1 Italian shipyard (requires Italia DLC)
achievements.summary: Deliver cargo to an Italian shipyard.

steps.text: Deliver to a shipyard in @loc{Ancona}, @loc{Messina} or @loc{Olbia}.

achievements.description: Visit Etna and Vesuvius volcanoes (requires Italia DLC)
achievements.summary: Visit both the Etna and Vesuvius volcanoes.

steps.text: Pass @loc{Etna} on highway A18 south of Messina, Sicily.
Pass @loc{Vesuvius} on highway A2 southeast of Naples.

achievements.description: Enter Rome from at least 3 corridors that lead to it (requires Italia DLC)
achievements.summary: Enter Rome from three of its four highway corridors.

steps.text: Enter @loc{Rome} on three different highways from this list: A1 (southeast), A24 (northeast), A90 (north) and A91 (west).

achievements.description: Complete a delivery from Carrara quarry (requires Italia DLC)
achievements.summary: Finish a job that starts at the Carrara quarry.

steps.text: Start a job at the quarry north of @loc{Livorno}. It is a fictional company, not called Carrara.

achievements.description: Deliver first oversize cargo (requires Special Transport DLC)
achievements.summary: Deliver your first oversize cargo.

steps.text: Take a job whose cargo picture has a red-and-white stripe beside it, and deliver it.

achievements.description: Complete at least 10 unique deliveries of oversize cargoes (requires Special Transport DLC)
achievements.summary: Complete 10 different oversize cargo deliveries.

steps.text: Deliver ten different oversize cargoes. The Special Transport pack has 17: Articulated Dumper, Boiler Part, Construction Staircase, Excavator Bucket, Giant Silo, Haul Truck Chassis, Heat Exchanger, High-Tech Device, Huge Tyres, Industrial Condenser, Large Reservoir Tank, Locomotive CZ LOKO EffiShunter 1000, Railcar, Massive Tech Part, Service Boat, Underground Loader and Wind Turbine Blade.

achievements.description: Complete deliveries on at least 10 oversize routes in base game (requires Special Transport DLC)
achievements.summary: Complete oversize deliveries on 10 of the base game's oversize routes.

collectibles.name: Berlin to Szczecin
collectibles.method: Take the oversize job from Berlin. It always ends in Szczecin.

collectibles.name: Bratislava to Graz
collectibles.method: Take the oversize job from Bratislava. It always ends in Graz.

collectibles.name: Bremen to Travemünde
collectibles.method: Take the oversize job from Bremen. It always ends in Travemünde.

collectibles.name: Brussels to Amsterdam
collectibles.method: Take the oversize job from Brussels. It always ends in Amsterdam.

collectibles.name: Cardiff to Birmingham
collectibles.method: Take the oversize job from Cardiff. It always ends in Birmingham.

collectibles.name: Cologne to Amsterdam
collectibles.method: Take the oversize job from Cologne. It always ends in Amsterdam.

collectibles.name: Dijon to Geneva
collectibles.method: Take the oversize job from Dijon. It always ends in Geneva.

collectibles.name: Dortmund to Hannover
collectibles.method: Take the oversize job from Dortmund. It always ends in Hannover.

collectibles.name: Glasgow to Aberdeen
collectibles.method: Take the oversize job from Glasgow. It always ends in Aberdeen.

collectibles.name: Linz to Brno
collectibles.method: Take the oversize job from Linz. It always ends in Brno.

collectibles.name: London to Felixstowe
collectibles.method: Take the oversize job from London. It always ends in Felixstowe.

collectibles.name: Luxembourg to Liège
collectibles.method: Take the oversize job from Luxembourg. It always ends in Liège.

collectibles.name: Munich to Salzburg
collectibles.method: Take the oversize job from Munich. It always ends in Salzburg.

collectibles.name: Plymouth to Dover
collectibles.method: Take the oversize job from Plymouth. It always ends in Dover.

collectibles.name: Prague to Nuremberg
collectibles.method: Take the oversize job from Prague. It always ends in Nuremberg.

collectibles.name: Reims to Strasbourg
collectibles.method: Take the oversize job from Reims. It always ends in Strasbourg.

collectibles.name: Rostock to Berlin
collectibles.method: Take the oversize job from Rostock. It always ends in Berlin.

collectibles.name: Sheffield to Birmingham
collectibles.method: Take the oversize job from Sheffield. It always ends in Birmingham.

achievements.description: Complete 3 consecutive oversize jobs without any damage (requires Special Transport DLC)
achievements.summary: Complete three oversize jobs in a row without any damage.

steps.text: Do three oversize jobs back to back and deliver each with no damage.
Drive slowly. Escort vehicles clear the road for you.

achievements.description: Complete delivery of the Silo cargo (requires Special Transport DLC)
achievements.summary: Deliver the Giant Silo oversize cargo.

steps.text: Take the oversize job with the Giant Silo and deliver it.

achievements.description: Complete delivery of the Haul Truck Chassis (requires Special Transport DLC)
achievements.summary: Deliver the Haul Truck Chassis oversize cargo.

steps.text: Take the oversize job with the Haul Truck Chassis and deliver it.

achievements.description: Complete delivery of the Service Boat (requires Special Transport DLC)
achievements.summary: Deliver the Service Boat oversize cargo.

steps.text: Take the oversize job with the Service Boat and deliver it.

achievements.description: Deliver at least 195 tons of oversized cargo in just 3 consecutive deliveries (requires Special Transport DLC)
achievements.summary: Deliver at least 195 tons of oversize cargo in three jobs in a row.

steps.text: Pick three oversize cargoes that add up to at least 195 tons. Repeats are allowed.
Include a Heat Exchanger (70 t) or the Locomotive CZ LOKO EffiShunter 1000 (80 t); otherwise you cannot reach 195.
Deliver the three jobs back to back.

achievements.description: Discover at least 20 Beyond the Baltic Sea DLC cities (requires Beyond the Baltic Sea DLC)
achievements.summary: Discover 20 cities from the Beyond the Baltic Sea DLC.

guide.context: Of Finland, only Turku, Tampere, Pori, Olkiluoto, Naantali, Loviisa, Lahti, Kouvola, Kotka and Helsinki count.

steps.text: Drive into 20 cities in Estonia, Latvia, Lithuania, Russia and the listed parts of Finland. A visited city turns yellow.

achievements.description: Complete excellent deliveries between the following countries: Russia - Lithuania; Lithuania - Latvia; Latvia - Estonia; Estonia - Russia; Russia - Finland. Any order or direction counts (requires Beyond the Baltic Sea DLC)
achievements.summary: Complete excellent deliveries between Estonia and Latvia, Estonia and Russia, Finland and Russia, Latvia and Lithuania, and Lithuania and Russia, in any order or direction.

steps.text: Do one perfect delivery for each pair, in any order or direction: Estonia and Latvia, Estonia and Russia, Finland and Russia, Latvia and Lithuania, and Lithuania and Russia.

achievements.description: Complete 5 deliveries from Kaliningrad to any other Russian city (requires Beyond the Baltic Sea DLC)
achievements.summary: Complete five deliveries from Kaliningrad to other Russian cities.

steps.text: Start five jobs in @loc{Kaliningrad}.
Deliver them to Luga, Pskov, Sosnovy Bor, St. Petersburg or Vyborg. The same city can repeat. Pskov is the shortest.

achievements.description: Complete 10 deliveries from concrete plants (requires Beyond the Baltic Sea DLC)
achievements.summary: Complete 10 deliveries that start at concrete plants in the Baltic region.

steps.text: Start ten jobs at concrete plants in @loc{Tartu}, @loc{Kouvola}, @loc{Tampere} or @loc{St. Petersburg}.
The plant is the start point. You may reuse one plant. The company Radus in other expansions does not count.

achievements.description: Make 2 deliveries to locomotive, furniture and paper mill factories (requires Beyond the Baltic Sea DLC)
achievements.summary: Deliver twice to a locomotive factory, twice to a furniture factory and twice to a paper mill in the Baltic countries.

steps.text: Make two deliveries to locomotive factories in @loc{Daugavpils} or @loc{Riga}.
Make two deliveries to furniture factories in @loc{Tartu}, @loc{Helsinki}, @loc{Daugavpils}, @loc{Rēzekne}, @loc{Riga} or @loc{Šiauliai}.
Make two deliveries to paper mills in @loc{Kunda}, @loc{Kouvola}, @loc{Tampere} or @loc{Vilnius}.
Keep a list of finished jobs because that is six deliveries in total.

achievements.description: Deliver cargo to at least 4 farms in Beyond the Baltic Sea DLC (requires Beyond the Baltic Sea DLC)
achievements.summary: Deliver cargo to 4 farms in the Baltic countries.

steps.text: Deliver to four farms. There are 16: Narva, Pärnu (two), Tartu, Helsinki, Kouvola, Daugavpils, Liepāja (two), Riga, Valmiera, Ventspils, Utena (two), Kaliningrad and St. Petersburg.
A city with two farms lets you use both.

achievements.description: Discover at least 2 Sardinian cities (requires Italia DLC)
achievements.summary: Discover two Sardinian cities.

steps.text: Drive into two cities on Sardinia.

achievements.displayName: All Around the Isle of Beauty
achievements.description: Discover at least 4 Corsican cities (requires Vive la France ! DLC)
achievements.summary: Discover four Corsican cities.

steps.text: Drive into four cities on Corsica. A visited city turns yellow on the map.

achievements.description: Discover at least 20 Road to the Black Sea DLC cities (requires Road to the Black Sea DLC)
achievements.summary: Discover 20 cities from the Road to the Black Sea DLC.

steps.text: Drive into 20 cities in Bulgaria, Romania and Turkey. A visited city turns yellow.

achievements.description: Visit at least 4 border crossings between Romania, Bulgaria and Turkey (requires Road to the Black Sea DLC)
achievements.summary: Pass through 4 border crossings on the Romania, Bulgaria and Turkey frontiers.

guide.context: All five crossings sit on Bulgaria's borders, so you can reach four by driving only around Bulgaria.

collectibles.name: Craiova crossing
collectibles.method: Spot the dark blue customs-officer symbol and drive through.

collectibles.name: Bucharest-Ruse crossing
collectibles.method: Spot the dark blue customs-officer symbol and drive through.

collectibles.name: Mangalia-Varna crossing
collectibles.method: Spot the dark blue customs-officer symbol and drive through.

collectibles.name: Edirne crossing, first
collectibles.method: Spot the dark blue customs-officer symbol and drive through.

collectibles.name: Edirne crossing, second
collectibles.method: Spot the dark blue customs-officer symbol and drive through.

achievements.description: Use a river ferry (requires Road to the Black Sea DLC)

steps.text: Take the river ferry in Romania, south of @loc{Galați}.

achievements.description: Complete 3 deliveries from Istanbul which are at least 2,500 km long (requires Road to the Black Sea and Going East DLCs)
achievements.summary: Complete 3 deliveries from Istanbul that are each at least 2,500 km long.

guide.context: This also needs the Going East! DLC.

steps.text: Spend six skill points on @mechanic{Long Distance}.
Start three jobs in @loc{Istanbul} of at least 2,500 km and deliver them. Each takes about an hour.

achievements.description: Complete excellent deliveries between these coastal cities: Istanbul-Burgas, Burgas-Varna, Varna-Mangalia, MangaliaConstanța. Any order or direction counts (requires Road to the Black Sea DLC)
achievements.summary: Complete excellent deliveries between Constanța and Mangalia, Mangalia and Varna, Varna and Burgas, and Burgas and Istanbul, in any order or direction.

steps.text: Do one perfect delivery for each pair, in any order or direction: Constanța and Mangalia, Mangalia and Varna, Varna and Burgas, and Burgas and Istanbul.
Raise the setting for preferring short distances in the gameplay settings to see short jobs more often.
Mangalia is just one company, so jobs to or from it are rare. Set Mangalia as the destination when starting from Constanța or Varna.

achievements.description: Complete deliveries between following cities, in this order and direction: Paris-Strasbourg, Strasbourg-Munich, Munich-Vienna, Vienna-Budapest, Budapest-Bucharest, Bucharest-Istanbul (requires Road to the Black Sea and Going East DLCs)
achievements.summary: Deliver cargo between six city pairs in order: Paris to Strasbourg, Strasbourg to Munich, Munich to Vienna, Vienna to Budapest, Budapest to Bucharest and Bucharest to Istanbul.

guide.context: This also needs the Going East! DLC.

steps.text: Deliver any cargo from @loc{Paris} to @loc{Strasbourg}.
Then deliver Strasbourg to Munich, Munich to Vienna, Vienna to Budapest, Budapest to Bucharest and Bucharest to Istanbul, in that order and direction.
Progress is saved after each leg, so you can continue later.

achievements.description: Discover at least 30 cities in Iberia (requires Iberia DLC)
achievements.summary: Discover 30 cities in Iberia.

steps.text: Drive into 30 cities in Portugal and Spain. A visited city turns yellow.

achievements.description: Deliver cargo to at least 4 container ports in Iberia (requires Iberia DLC)
achievements.summary: Deliver cargo to 4 container ports in Iberia.

steps.text: Deliver to any four of the eleven container ports: Vigo, Valencia, Tarragona, Málaga, Gijón, Bilbao, Barcelona, Algeciras, Sines, Porto and Lisbon.

achievements.description: Deliver ADR cargo to at least 2 solar power plants in Iberia (requires Iberia DLC)
achievements.summary: Deliver ADR cargo to 2 solar power plants in Iberia.

steps.text: Spend a point on the @mechanic{ADR} skill. More points make jobs easier to find.
Deliver ADR cargo to two of the five plants in Spain: Badajoz, Ciudad Real, Granada, Puertollano and Seville.

achievements.description: Deliver cargo to at least 3 shipyards in Iberia (requires Iberia DLC)
achievements.summary: Deliver cargo to 3 shipyards in Iberia.

steps.text: Deliver to three of the four shipyards: Setúbal, Algeciras, Gijón and Vigo.

achievements.description: Complete a delivery from Lisbon, Seville, and Pamplona to A Coruña (requires Iberia DLC)
achievements.summary: Complete deliveries to A Coruña starting from Lisbon, from Seville and from Pamplona.

steps.text: Start a job in @loc{Lisbon} with any company in @loc{A Coruña} as the destination and deliver it.
Do the same from @loc{Seville} and from @loc{Pamplona}.

achievements.summary: View cutscenes from 12 viewpoints in Iberia.

guide.context: The list has 15 viewpoints, and you need any 12.

achievements.description: Complete 20 deliveries choosing the trailer delivery option which requires reversing
achievements.summary: Finish 20 deliveries using the parking option that needs reversing.

steps.text: When a job ends, choose the trailer parking option that makes you reverse at least once. It is usually the hardest one.
Park the trailer yourself. Do not use autoparking.
Repeat until you have done 20 deliveries this way.

achievements.description: Complete a perfect delivery (no damage, no fines, in-time) between Pristina and Bijelo Polje (requires West Balkans DLC)
achievements.summary: Finish a perfect delivery on a job linking Pristina and Bijelo Polje.

steps.text: Start a job in either @loc{Pristina} or @loc{Bijelo Polje} with the other as the destination.
Drive the narrow mountain pass slowly. It has many sharp corners. Arrive on time with no fines and no cargo damage.

achievements.description: Complete 3 deliveries along the coast in this order: Rijeka - Zadar - Split - Niksic (requires West Balkans DLC)
achievements.summary: Complete three deliveries in order: Rijeka to Zadar, Zadar to Split, and Split to Nikšić.

steps.text: Deliver any cargo from @loc{Rijeka} to @loc{Zadar}.
Then deliver Zadar to @loc{Split}, and Split to @loc{Nikšić}, in that order and direction.
Progress saves after each leg, so you can pause between them.

achievements.description: Deliver the following cargoes from companies in West Balkans to complete a production chain in this order: Ore, Aluminium Ingots, Electrical Wiring, Electronics, Campervans (requires West Balkans DLC)
achievements.summary: Complete the campervan production chain: Ore, Aluminium Ingots, Electrical Wiring, Electronics, then Campervans, each from a West Balkans company in that order.

steps.text: Steps 1 and 2 start at the same company. Pick one of: Karakaj, Mostar, Nikšić or Podgorica. Deliver @item{Ore} first, then @item{Aluminium Ingots}.
Step 3: start a job with @item{Electrical Wiring} at a company in Tirana, Vlorë, Mostar, Tuzla, Zadar, Pristina or Novi Sad.
Step 4: start a job with @item{Electronics} at a company in Tirana, Vlorë, Sarajevo, Belgrade, Niš or Maribor.
Step 5: start a job with @item{Campervans} at the company in @loc{Novo Mesto}, Slovenia.
Only the starting company matters. Search the job list by cargo name.

achievements.description: Complete the first scenario of the first chapter in Truck Driving Basics (Driving Academy)
achievements.summary: Finish scenario one of chapter one in Truck Driving Basics.

steps.text: Start @mechanic{Truck Driving Basics} in the Driving Academy and finish the first scenario of chapter one.

achievements.description: Complete at least 6 scenarios in the fourth chapter of Truck Driving Basics while using only the interior camera (Driving Academy)
achievements.summary: Complete six scenarios in chapter four of Truck Driving Basics using only the interior camera.

steps.text: Do not press any number key to change the camera.
Complete six scenarios in chapter four. The first few are shorter and easier.

achievements.description: Complete at least 28 scenarios in Truck Driving Basics including the final exams (Driving Academy)
achievements.summary: Finish 28 Truck Driving Basics scenarios, final exams included.

steps.text: The achievement needs 28 scenarios, but the final exams unlock only after all earlier scenarios, so plan on playing all 31 of Truck Driving Basics.
Follow every instruction, even odd ones. Breaking one ends the scenario.

achievements.description: Complete any scenario in fourth chapter of Truck Driving Basics in one attempt without correcting by driving forward (Driving Academy)
achievements.summary: Pass a chapter four scenario of Truck Driving Basics on the first try, never driving forward to fix your position.

steps.text: Play scenario one of chapter four, where you mostly back up in a straight line.
Go slowly and adjust while reversing. Do not drive forward to correct.

achievements.description: Complete 20 scenarios in chapters two, three or four using manual transmission in Truck Driving Basics (Driving Academy)
achievements.summary: Pass 20 Truck Driving Basics scenarios from chapter two, three or four while shifting gears yourself.

steps.text: In the main menu open Options, then Controls, and change the transmission mode from @mechanic{Simple Automatic} to @mechanic{Sequential}.
Enable @mechanic{Smart Sequential Shifting} to make it easier. It still counts.
Shift with Shift (up) and Ctrl (down) while you play 20 different scenarios in chapters two to four.

achievements.description: Complete any 5 scenarios in a row without failure from the third or fourth chapter in Truck Driving Basics (Driving Academy)
achievements.summary: Complete five different scenarios in a row without failing, in chapter three or four of Truck Driving Basics.

steps.text: Pick five different scenarios from chapter three or four. The first five of chapter three are fairly easy.
Play them back to back without failing any of them. Drive slowly and follow the instructions.

achievements.summary: Deliver cargo to 4 hotels in Greece.

steps.text: Deliver to four of the five hotels: Argostoli, Chania, Chios, Mitilini and Rhodes.

achievements.description: Deliver olives or olive oil from Eliarchos Olive Farm to 5 different cities in Greece (requires Greece DLC)
achievements.summary: Deliver olives or olive oil from Eliarchos Olive Farm to 5 different cities in Greece.

steps.text: Start every job at an olive farm company, in @loc{Kalamata} or @loc{Mitilini}.
Take only olives or olive oil. The destination must be in Greece.
Use a different destination city for each of the five jobs.
Reload the job list as often as needed to find matching jobs.

achievements.description: Deliver 3 Marble Blocks and 3 undamaged Marble Slabs from Rock Eater Quarry in Greece (requires Greece DLC)
achievements.summary: Deliver 3 Marble Blocks and 3 undamaged Marble Slabs from Rock Eater Quarry in Greece.

steps.text: Start the jobs at a quarry company in @loc{Argostoli}, @loc{Athens}, @loc{Kavala} or @loc{Lamia}. The start point is what counts.
Deliver 3 marble blocks and 3 marble slabs. Keep the slabs undamaged.
Check the cargo description to tell a block from a slab. Marble from a different Greek company does not count.

achievements.description: Complete the pass conditions in at least 23 scenarios in Truck Driving Proficiency (Driving Academy)
achievements.summary: Meet the pass conditions in 23 scenarios of Truck Driving Proficiency.

steps.text: Play Truck Driving Proficiency, which has 26 scenarios. Meet the pass goal in 23 of them.
Press F2 to turn on the mirror view for extra vision.
Practice hard scenarios many times, or watch a video for the tricky corners.

achievements.description: Obtain 3 stars in at least 15 scenarios in Truck Driving Proficiency (Driving Academy)
achievements.summary: Earn 3 stars in 15 scenarios of Truck Driving Proficiency.

steps.text: Besides the pass goal, each scenario gives stars for three goals: use only the interior camera, keep direction changes under the limit, and finish within the time limit. The limits differ per scenario.
Early scenarios are easier, so start there and earn all 3 stars in 15 scenarios.

achievements.description: Obtain 3 stars in any 3 scenarios played in a row in Truck Driving Proficiency (Driving Academy)
achievements.summary: Get 3 stars in each of three Truck Driving Proficiency scenarios played one after another.

steps.text: Choose three of the easier early scenarios.
Play them back to back and earn 3 stars in each.

achievements.description: Discover at least 20 cities in Nordic Horizons (requires Nordic Horizons DLC)
achievements.summary: Discover 20 cities in Nordic Horizons.

guide.context: Only the DLC's own cities count. Finland: Vaasa, Tornio, Rovaniemi, Oulu, Mikkeli, Lappeenranta, Kuusamo, Kuopio, Kokkola, Kajaani, Jyväskylä, Joensuu, Ivalo. Norway: Tromsø, Trondheim, Svolvær, Steinkjer, Narvik, Mo i Rana, Lillehammer, Kristiansund, Honningsvåg, Hamar, Dombås, Bodø, Andenes, Alta, Ålesund. Sweden: Umeå, Sundsvall, Skellefteå, Östersund, Örnsköldsvik, Luleå, Kiruna, Karesuando, Haparanda, Gävle, Falun, Borlänge, Arvidsjaur.

steps.text: Drive into 20 cities in the Nordic Horizons areas of Finland, Norway and Sweden. A visited city turns yellow.

achievements.summary: Haul two Salmon Fillet loads that start in Tromsø or Alta and end in two different countries.

steps.text: Salmon Fillet rarely shows in the freight market. It is easier to use your own insulated or refrigerated trailer and open the cargo market.
Load @item{Salmon Fillet} in @loc{Tromsø} or @loc{Alta}. Alta usually has more refrigerated cargo.
Deliver one load to Sweden and one to Finland, or any two countries other than Norway. You can start from the same city twice.

achievements.description: Complete excellent deliveries in this order and direction: Ivalo - Kiruna - Svolvær (requires Nordic Horizons DLC)
achievements.summary: Complete excellent deliveries in order: Ivalo to Kiruna, then Kiruna to Svolvær.

steps.text: Deliver any cargo from @loc{Ivalo} to @loc{Kiruna} with no damage, no fines and on time.
Then deliver Kiruna to @loc{Svolvær} the same way.
Progress saves after each leg.

achievements.description: Complete at least 12 scenarios in Double Trailer Handling (Driving Academy)
achievements.summary: Complete 12 scenarios in Double Trailer Handling.

steps.text: Play Double Trailer Handling, which has 18 scenarios.
Finish 12 of them. You may skip the hardest ones. There are no star, time or camera limits.
